basis: The maintainer requested bringing an optional clipboard operation from a local copy into the existing Skill and listing stored website services and usernames without reading passwords. The repository implementation was written independently.
local_changes: List the service names of managed website entries and the usernames of one selected website using Keychain attributes only.
Document the explicit-copy trigger and the fallback to Keychain Access.
Resolve a unique Generic Password item by reference before reading its UTF-8 data and writing it to the current Mac's clipboard.
Report only operation status. Preserve existing permissions and keep the value in process memory until it is copied.
source_review: The referenced Apple API and tool documentation was consulted for platform behavior and API use. No external code or workflow text is distributed in the Skill.
